summer_gate: 2,928 hour-ending local June-September timestamps, unique, finite, positive and with zero gross outliers
gross_outlier: more than 10 times the area's finite-positive summer median; 5 and 20 times archived as screen diagnostics
unresolved_anomaly_action: invalidate the entire common year; do not clip, interpolate or replace with a forecast
secondary_SPP_check: exclude the point and rerank 2023 plus 2025 as an incomplete-season diagnostic only
scope_evidence: purpose, other_info, facility_name, information_source and all eight saved source URL fields
use_classification: affirmative purpose-only pure tags separated from narrative mixed/transition and uncertain references; no crypto MW fraction inferred
campus_selection: each allocation rule resolves status, mapping and positive-weight eligibility before selecting the largest reported MW with source row tie-breaker
unknown_addresses: placeholder or non-street addresses receive record-specific keys
output_load_fields: reference_candidate_gross_path_GW is unchanged input; candidate_GW is the actual case-specific increment
